description: LTDS Appendix 6 - Fault Level Data is a dataset listed in Northern Powergrid open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Northern Powergrid. Our LTDS Appendix 6 dataset contains data on faults, fault calculations and fault conditions on Northern Powergrid's HV and EHV circuits. The data within Appendix 6 was derived from the latest Fault Level Survey and the values quoted are based on connected generation. This does not include any future connected generation (accepted schemes). Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal files it under Network. Its keywords are Long Term Development Statement (LTDS), Extra High Voltage (EHV), Earthing. The portal shows 2025-11-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Northern Powergrid Open Data Licence v1.0 (https://northernpowergrid.opendatasoft.com/p/opendatalicence/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-npg-open-data-portal.
